description: This file manages synchronization of external CLI credentials (MiniMax CLI and Codex CLI) into an authentication profile store, including credential comparison, provider resolution, and credential updating logic.

methods.name: areOAuthCredentialsEquivalent
methods.description: Compares two OAuthCredential objects for equivalence based on their properties.

methods.name: shouldReplaceStoredOAuthCredential
methods.description: Determines if a stored OAuthCredential should be replaced with a new one.

methods.name: readManagedExternalCliCredential
methods.description: Reads external CLI credentials for a given profile and credential, returning the credential with managedBy info.

methods.name: syncExternalCliCredentials
methods.description: Synchronizes external CLI credentials from MiniMax and Codex into the profile store.
